questions.q: What emotional step did Clinton find hardest after the election loss?
questions.why: She said it was harder to call Obama to apologize than to call Trump.

questions.q: What coping strategy did Clinton emphasize to avoid cynicism?
questions.why: She learned to lean on friends and family for comfort.

questions.q: Why does Clinton claim her campaign struggled to convey her motives?
questions.why: She says she doesn't boast, making it hard to display qualifications.

questions.q: How did the media's coverage of Clinton's email issue compare to her policies?
a: Three times more minutes on emails
questions.why: Nightly TV news spent three times as many minutes on the emails.

questions.q: What does Clinton describe as one of her top regrets from her time as Secretary of State?
questions.why: She cites the private email account as a major regret.
